d: Mohammed Siraj’s omission from India’s playing XI in the second IND v NZ Test has again picked some heat, especially after everything the Indian fast bowler has put into the team. From his tireless spells in Test cricket to his crucial role in India’s pace attack alongside Jasprit Bumrah, Siraj has built a reputation as one of the side’s most dependable workhorses. So, was leaving him out the right call by the Shubman Gill-led team? And what does his absence mean for India’s bowling combination against New Zealand with WTC on the line? Rupha Ramani looks at the debate surrounding Siraj’s…
